fusions.name: Torpid Blow
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy with chilled iron, dealing 12 damage, [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, [Stunned] for 1 second and [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Chilled Spittle
fusions.desc: Spits cold, metallic venom that deals 7 damage. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Shed and Regrow
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds, raises your physical resistance by 10%, and lifts 1 condition from you.

fusions.name: Basking Hide
fusions.desc: By day, your armour rises by 12%.
